title: Rory and the Quiet Clover Glen
verses:
The silver moon began to rise
Above the sleepy hill,
While Rory walked along the path
Where everything was still.

And Nia glided through the air
To show the way ahead,
Where fluffy clover softly grew
To make a cozy bed.

Then Ricky slowed his tiptoe feet
And left his playful game,
While Tilly hummed a quiet tune
As gentle evening came.

And Benny settled near the trees
To take a soothing rest,
While Psittaco found sleepy leaves
To build a sheltered nest.

Then Rory gave a sleepy yawn
Beneath the purple sky,
As crickets played a soothing song
To be their lullaby.

The twinkling stars began to blink
To keep them warm and bright,
And Rory closed his heavy eyes
And whispered soft, "Goodnight."
